subject: general
question: Which of the following sectors engaged the largest percentage of women workers in the year 2019-2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Agriculture engaged the **largest percentage of women workers** in India during the year 2019-2020.
 
• According to the Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS), a significant proportion of rural women workers were employed in **agricultural activities**, including crop production, livestock rearing, and allied tasks.
 
• Women constituted around **55%-60% of the agricultural labor force** in India, highlighting their critical role in the sector.
 
• Tasks performed by women in agriculture include **sowing, weeding, harvesting, and post-harvest processing**, which are essential for agricultural productivity.
 
• The dependency on agriculture for livelihoods remains high among rural women due to limited opportunities in other sectors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gender Roles in Agriculture:**

 
 
• Women in agriculture often perform labor-intensive tasks and are involved in both subsistence farming and commercial crop production.
 
• They contribute significantly to food security but face challenges such as limited access to resources, training, and decision-making power.
 
 
 
• **Rural Employment Trends:**
 
 
• Rural areas in India show a higher dependency on agriculture for employment, particularly among women.
 
• Non-farm opportunities like manufacturing and services are gradually increasing but remain limited for women.
 
 
 
• **Livelihood Diversification:**
 
 
• In recent years, women have started diversifying their livelihoods into allied sectors like **dairy farming, poultry, and fisheries** to supplement household incomes.
 
 
 
• **Challenges in Women’s Agricultural Work:**
 
 
• Women face challenges like **low wages, lack of land ownership, and limited access to credit**.
 
• Policy interventions like the **National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (NREGA)** aim to provide equal opportunities and fair wages to women workers.
